steps.text: Drip. Drop.
Is it raining?
He looks out the window. Lightning flashes across the sky, but the glass remains dry.
Tick, tock.
It must be the clock, then.
But he looks up at the clock, and sees that its hands have long since stopped, with only a broken wooden dummy swaying beneath.
What is going on?
His palm feels wet, as though liquid was dripping through his clenched fist and onto the ground, forming a viscous puddle.
He opens up his hand and sees that the hairs of his palm are soaked in blood.
Sinner.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Who's there?!
Hehe. You're already wearing unbreakable shackles, Anthony.

Another flash of lightning illuminates the corner of the dark room. A severed head lies on the ground, blood still gushing out from where it was separated from its body, leaving it lying in a pool of blood. It is the head that is speaking to him.
He remembers that face. It is a familiar one.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Val Hyde... where is your brother?

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: Where is he? Right by your feet.
He looks down to see a corpse lying on the ground. Its torso is turned away, yet its head has swiveled around to face him. The broken neck vertebrae protrude from the skin.

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: Why are you trembling, Anthony? You should be happy.

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: You've waited so long for this day. To kill your hated enemies with your own hands, and let their blood soak every inch of earth here.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Did... did I do all this?

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: Yes. Smile, Anthony. What a day. What a lovely day.

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: You've exacted your revenge, so why the long face? Hehehe.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No... it's too late.

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: Oh, my child, you came too late. Boo-hoo. Your mom and I didn't live to see the day you walked free again.

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: It's all too late. Our little Tony. Boo-hoo.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Shut up. Shut up!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Murderer! How dare you pretend to talk like my parents!

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: Murderer? Is he taking about us?

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: Yes, brother. He's talking about us.

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: But look around, Anthony. There's only one person in this room with blood on their hands.

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: It's you. You're the murderer.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You deserved it! You deserved to die by my hands!

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: Such brave words, such unwavering resolve. Everything is as you wanted, then. Why not smile, Anthony?

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: Why are your lips pursed like that? Come on, turn that frown upside down. Smile. Laugh. Do as I do.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Enough! Shut up!

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: Such terrifying eyes, brother. There's murder in them.

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: The eyes of a murderer! The eyes of a sinner!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Shut! Up!

steps.name: Broken Corpse
steps.text: Hahaha! We're waiting for you, Anthony. We'll see you in the flames of hell.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm already being burnt every day by the flames of revenge.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What do I care about the flames of hell, as long as I can tear you apart with my own two hands?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What does a charred corpse have to fear from the fire?

steps.name: Severed Head
steps.text: Then come find us, Anthony. Hahahaha.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I will. I'll step into the flames.
A fire burns in his eyes.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: It's that dream again... my head...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Covers face) What time is it...?

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: Good morning, operator. It is currently 04:24. Current weather is overcast, and the temperature is 26 degrees.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Four in the morning... only three hours of sleep, then.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Forget it, I can't get back to sleep.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: My sheets are soaked with sweat.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'll need to change them... the pillow, too.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: You have a new message, operator.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: Anthony, we found the money your dad left in Bunkerhill City. There's more than enough for us to make a comeback.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: Are you still haunted by what happened to your parents?

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: It's not your fault. HydeBro carried out their entire plan while you were in Mansfield. By the time we heard the news, it was already too late.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: The Hyde brothers are nothing if not thorough. It's a miracle that you're still alive.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: We went to great lengths to get in touch with you. Their eyes and ears are everywhere.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: Try to pull yourself together. We'll take back what belongs to us.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Control, Anthony... don't let violence overcome you... control...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Trembles)

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Damn it.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Damn it!
He picks up a chair and throws it at the wall, shattering the dressing mirror mounted there.
He sees his face reflected in the shards, twisted in anger.
Then, the fury fades.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Control, Anthony.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Anger and sorrow have never solved anything.
Training Room

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Gazes into distance)

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: (Hm, he looks distracted...)

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Snap out of it, big guy!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (She's fast... I might hurt her with a hard block. I'll just protect my head.)

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Where do you think you're looking?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Now she's aiming for my midsection!)

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Too late. It's all too late.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No—shut up!

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Oh no... I'm sorry, Shura. Are you alright?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: So that's how it is, big guy... You've never really come at me with your full strength, have you?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: We're in very different weight classes. I'm afraid you wouldn't be able to fight back.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Hmph! It wasn't that bad. Bring it on! Just... gimme a second to get up.

spans.text: bad. Bring it on! Just... gimme a second to get up.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Ow ow ow!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Apologies, I should have been more careful. I'll take you to sickbay.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: ...Eh, these things happen in training.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: You look distracted, though. What's the matter? Didn't get much sleep last night?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Yes... Maybe I was too absorbed in the book I was reading.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Well, nothing to worry about! Next time we're free, let's grab a few drinks together. That'll knock you right out, if you let 'em.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'd rather not even think about drinking until we get you to a doctor.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: How is she, Domma?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Asleep for now. We'll need to keep her a coupla days for observation, but it don't look too serious to me.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: How'd she get hurt?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I accidentally injured her today.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Don't look at me like that.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: You ain't the type to lose control, though...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Don't look so surprised, Domma. You've seen me in prison.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Yeah, which is why I know just how hard you been tryin' to hide that side of you.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: You look awful, Anthony.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...I've been having trouble sleeping. Seeing the same nightmare every night.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: In it, I'm standing in a pool of blood, with blood on my hands, and the Hyde brothers are lying dead on the ground.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: That's new, never had no dreams like that before. Somethin' happen?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Bad news from Bunkerhill City.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Your folks...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Educated guess?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Yeah, saw that letter on your desk when I was returnin' a book. Under a pile of books, but there ain't no hidin' those tear stains.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I've submitted my resignation and will be leaving in a few days. I've been here too long. It's time I faced it. Everything.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Figured this day'd come, sooner or later.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Sometimes, I can't help but think... what if you left all that behind and stayed here? Wouldn't that be swell?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I've considered it, Domma.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Once, I thought I would give up on revenge after I'd rescued my parents.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: But now, my only desire is to repay blood with blood.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: But you ain't never killed no one, Anthony.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: How does it feel? How does it feel to take a life with your own hands?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Can you tell me, Domma? How did it feel when you injected poison into a prisoner's veins? How did it feel when you sent the body to the incinerator for disposal?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: ...It hurt, at first. You feel sick, can't sleep, start seein' stuff that ain't there.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Then, you try to justify it. Tell yourself they deserved it, that you did the right thing.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Then, one day, when enough people have stopped breathin' on account of you, you stop feelin' anything at all. You seen enough death.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: That point, whatever crimes they did in life don't much matter no more. Their deaths don't neither.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Does it take a long time?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Yeah, long and painful. Had to keep remindin' myself it was just a job. But how 'bout you, Anthony?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: How would you get through it?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Seems to me you made up your mind to face it without givin' a single thought to how.

spans.text: Seems to me you made up your mind to face it without givin' a single thought to

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: We're goin' together, Anthony. I can help you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No, this is my problem. I can't drag you into this.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I's already in it. I helped break you outta Mansfield, 'member?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: That's enough, Domma, this is not open for discussion.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony—

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: A-Anthony!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Are you awake, Shura?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: I hearda you hadda bottle of fine whiskey... when will we getta have a taste of it?

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: How about next Wednesday? Ya free that day, and I'm free that day...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Huh? But you're injured. You shouldn't drink for a while.

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Injured... ya, I'm injured, can't drink...

steps.name: Beehunter
steps.text: Why... *sob* I'm so sad... *sob*

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Is she ok?)

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: (Must be the anesthetic.)

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (I see...)

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Promise me. Promise me you won't leave without sayin' goodbye.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Your exit papers are in order, sir. I'm sure you have plenty on your plate right now, so I took the liberty of bringing the paperwork over.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Sorry, and thank you. I should have come over to pick them up myself.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: It's fine, I just happened to be passing through. Have a nice day, sir.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You too.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Well, that went quicker than I anticipated.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Looks around)

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I should clean up before I leave. Fortunately, there isn't much here.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: These books... they can go to the library.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: These bottles of liquor... I'll drop them off in the wine storage room.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Oh, I almost forgot, the action movies I borrowed from Robin. I should remember to return them.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: A leaf bookmark from Kafka, and this doll... As I recall, a Christmas present from Pinecone.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What's with all the trinkets in this drawer? I don't even remember putting them there. No doubt the kids staying at Medical will enjoy them, though.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Well, that's about it. Now to start packing... I should only need a few changes of clothes.
He freezes.
The suit hangs in the middle of the wardrobe, clear as day. He remembers everything about it, from picking the cloth, to getting measured, to the delivery.
Everyone could see how much he liked it. Everyone thought he would wear it at every opportunity.
In fact, he has hardly ever done so.
He did not want to blemish it.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: You have a new message, operator.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: Got your message, Anthony. We've made arrangements to get you to Bunkerhill City. We have people waiting for you at Tkaronto.

steps.name: Communications Terminal
steps.text: I look forward to seeing you. Your parents, my brother... we have so many scores to settle with the Hyde brothers.
He lifts a hand and touches a tiny piece of embroidery on the collar.
It is in the shape of a tower.
Eventually, reluctantly, his arm comes back down again.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What a fool I was... Why did I buy this, knowing that I would eventually leave?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Such a fool.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Dr. Silence. Is Domma here?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sorry, Anthony, you might have to wait. She's treating a patient that came in this afternoon.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: May I wait for her here?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Of course. Water?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No, thank you. I wouldn't want to get in your way.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Alright, I'll be making my rounds.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Glances at watch)

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I hope there's enough time...

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Young man! Hey, young man!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Oh, sorry, were you speaking to me?

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Yeah, for a while now, but seems like you didn't hear me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I apologize; I was checking the time. Did you need something?

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: No, I just saw a hole in your shirt, so I was asking if you could come over so I could fix it.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Thank you. I suppose I didn't notice it because I was in a hurry.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: But I'm afraid I have to leave soon.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Sit down already. Just because I'm old doesn't mean my hands don't work. It'll only take a few minutes.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Thank you, ma'am.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: You're a friend of Dr. Domma's?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: That's what I thought. You're always stopping by to see her.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Are you a patient of hers?

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Yeah, she's really nice. I've got bad knees, and she's been a lot of help.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: She's always been kind like that.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: I guess you already know that she's leaving? She told me yesterday that I'm being handed over to Dr. Silence.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Is that so. What a shame.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Must've heard some dumb patient calling her a weirdo behind her back. Silly, really! She's so patient and detailed. You don't get many doctors like her.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I completely agree.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: But I guess that's that. Dr. Silence said she tried to convince her to stay, but she wouldn't change her mind.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: She may be gentle on the surface, but she's stubborn. Once she puts her mind to something, no one can change it.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: After relying on her for everything when I was stuck in a hospital bed, helping fix her friend's clothes is the least I could do.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: There, how's that?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Wonderful. Thank you.

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Oh, there's no need to thank me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: (Glances at watch)

steps.name: Old Woman
steps.text: Are you leaving?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Yes, I have to go.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You sure you don't want to wait? She'll be done in a minute.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Hold on, you're going by yourself? I thought she was coming with you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No, I came to say goodbye. I'm the only one who's leaving.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Oh, I must've misunderstood then. I could've sworn you were taking her with you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No, it's better for her to stay at Rhodes Island. My revenge is my own business. I don't want to drag anyone else into it.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Speaking of which, can you do something for me, Dr. Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Well, you can ask.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Can you give this book to her?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Just a book?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: And a message. Tell her that...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Tell her I haven't finished it yet. Tell her to keep it safe.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: When will you be back for it? What do I tell her?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Silence is the crueler answer, you know.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You take care. I need to go now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Anthony!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Anthony...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: ...*sigh*.
Silence looks down and sees that the corner of one page has been folded. She opens the book and sees an illustration.
A man stands in a prison cell, his back to the window, his face obscured by shadows and iron bars. He extends a wilted finger through the bars and out beyond the picture.
There is a single line of text beneath the illustration.

a.text: I have sinned. I have killed. I seek no sympathy, no forgiveness, no salvation. I seek only suffering, and eternal torment.
